scope: Actual Chromium and production OCPP page, HTTP guards, real authenticated idle session and CSRF; controller persistence and OCPP module status are doubles. No physical station or plant. Visibility/BFcache events simulated.

checks.name: desktop production page, exact hosted namespace/PID/port, station text escaped, known datapoints
five-second real timer refresh, one in-flight GET, edited draft preserved
real CSRF/revision protected save preserves hidden imported compatibility values
invalid privileged port, no protocol and malformed station identity blocked before write
409 concurrent change retains draft; explicit reload restores stored revision
legacy import through guarded API retains legacy namespace and stays disabled until reviewed
failed health request removes green state; successful request restores confirmed snapshot
unavailable child status cannot turn cached station values into a confirmed active module
hidden tab aborts active poll; resume and BFcache produce one immediate refresh
fresh permission loss disables writes, clears confirmed status and stops polling
explicit refresh after renewed administrator access retains edited draft and restores guarded save
